name: PlexHarvester
description: PlexHarvester compares your local Plex library against shared remote servers, indexes FTP sources for automatic downloading, and provides MKV audio track management via MKVToolNix. Includes library snapshots, multilingual interface (FR/EN), and a real-time log viewer.

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Persistent storage for configuration, cache, and logs.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the PlexHarvester web interface.

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Flask secret key for session security. If left empty, a key is auto-generated and saved to /config/secret_key.txt on first start.

variables.name: Config Path (internal)
variables.description: Internal path for configuration files. Do not change unless you have a specific reason.
